links.outcome: Engagement, symptoms, and adverse events for genAI therapy app versus PDF CBT workbooks in randomized trial
links.effect: App group had 2.4 times higher usage frequency and 3.8 times longer usage durations; similar overall symptom improvement; no increase in adverse events versus standard care.
links.quote: Importantly, the app was safe, with no increase in adverse events compared to standard care.

unlisted_practices: Personalizing CBT content with generative AI to increase patient engagement with digital mental health interventions

screen.reason: Randomized controlled trial evaluating the safety, clinical outcomes, and engagement of a generative AI conversational agent (Limbic Care) providing CBT compared to static PDF workbooks in adults with anxiety or depression.
